title: Bound on Nonzero Vector Fourier Coefficients
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ have the property that every nonempty Fourier coefficient of the corresponding function on the sign cube has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$. Then for every nonzero $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ indexed by $\gamma$ has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Every nonempty Fourier coefficient of the corresponding sign-cube function has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$
